about: The pipeline roots registry (S108 Lane E). Every filesystem root the desktop converter lane touches under the pipeline tree is NAMED here once and resolved only through fp_paths.py. `path` is relative to the resolved pipeline root ('.' = the root itself); `env` names the override that relocates it - FP_PIPELINE moves the whole tree, which is how the deferral-gate tripwire runs real code against an isolated scratch root instead of the live library (SYM-010's class). Names are File Portal's own vocabulary.

library.role: the pipeline root itself - every other root lives under it; FP_PIPELINE relocates the whole tree

anchor.role: converted-bundle library - dot-then-atomic delivery lands finished bundles here; the exporter ships from it

pending.role: deferred-analyst queue - conversions parked for the widget's pre-flight card (analyst-mode 'ask')

held.role: audit-failed bundles (enforce mode; the assay card reads these)

drop.role: watched arrivals folder - drop a PDF here and the conveyor converts it

drop_done.role: successful conversions archived out of drop/ (also read by prototypes/repair-bench and docling-calibration, not yet on this registry)

drop_failed.role: failed conversions archived out of drop/ with the error logged

events.role: append-only pipeline event stream the widget tails - reconstructible truth on disk (docs/13)

rules.role: analyst pre-flight rules the Tauri card folds into its JSON

analyst_mode.role: analyst routing lever: off | local | gemini | ask - re-read before every conversion

analyst_progress.role: per-chunk analyst heartbeat - overwritten every chunk; the file's mtime is the liveness the widget ages

analyst_work.role: chunk-level resume journal (S61) - each finished chunk lands here the moment it exists

audit_mode.role: survival-audit mode lever: report | enforce (docs/15 s12)

gpu_lock.role: converter busy SIGNAL, not a lock (SYM-032) - written by the watcher, read by room-chat and the parity bench

chat_hold.role: the assistant's claim on the card - written by room_chat.py ONLY; the watcher's deferral gate reads it

convert_progress.role: live convert progress the widget's line.rs reads while .gpu-lock is held (S42; entirely best-effort)

convert_estimate.role: the conversion's ledger-fed promise - Python is the only authority; line.rs projects it verbatim (docs/19 s5)

chunk_batch.role: slice recognition-batch USER LEVER: 8 | 16 | 32 - re-read per slice

chunk_work.role: completed chunked-convert slices keyed (source_sha16, page_range) - resume survives the process that made them

conversion_ledger.role: one learning record per successful conversion - the estimator reads SIMILAR past works from it (docs/18 s5.2)

figure_triage.role: figure-coverage triage lever file: mode + thresholds (consumer figure_coverage.py, not yet on this registry)
